lines.en: label ayanedorm25:
I knock on Ayane’s door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Ayane 的门，等她回应。

lines.en: : Coming, Sensei! Give me one second!
lines.zh: : 来了，老师！给我一秒钟！

lines.en: : Can’t I just walk in? I’m pretty sure I’m desensitized to seeing you naked at this point.
lines.zh: : 我不能自己进去吗？我觉得我到这地步已经对看你裸体脱敏了。

lines.en: : A - Rude! You should always be excited to see me naked.
lines.zh: : A——粗鲁！你应该永远为看到我裸体而兴奋。

lines.en: : B - We’re going somewhere tonight and I’m just grabbing some stuff.
lines.zh: : B——我们今晚要出去，我只是在收拾点东西。

lines.en: : Do you need a towel?
lines.zh: : 你需要毛巾吗？

lines.en: : What? Why would I need a towel?
lines.zh: : 什么？我为什么需要毛巾？

lines.en: I hear Ayane close her wardrobe through the thin walls of the dorm before she opens the door and joins me in the hall.
lines.zh: 隔着宿舍薄薄的墙，我听见 Ayane 关上衣柜，然后她开了门，到走廊跟我汇合。

lines.en: scene ayanebathredux1
: You need a towel because we’re going to go take a bath together and the towels they give you in public bathhouses are kind of bleh.
lines.zh: : 你需要毛巾，因为我们要一起去洗澡，而公共澡堂给你的毛巾有点……凑合。

lines.en: : Correct me if I’m wrong here, but I’m pretty sure there isn’t really a public bathhouse anywhere that would be okay with the two of us bathing together.
lines.zh: : 要是我说错了你纠正我，不过我很确定没有什么公共澡堂会同意我俩一起泡。

lines.en: scene ayanebathredux2
: And that's where you're wrong, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 而这点上你就错了，老师！

lines.en: : Under normal circumstances, that would be correct-
lines.zh: : 正常情况下，你是对的——

lines.en: : But lucky for us, I have discovered through the power of money that I can rent out the mens’ side of the local bathhouse for a very negligible amount of money.
lines.zh: : 不过我们运气好，我靠着金钱的力量发现：我可以花一笔微不足道的钱，把本地澡堂的男汤包下来。

lines.en: : What exactly is a negligible amount of money to you, Ayane?
lines.zh: : 对你来说，多少钱算「微不足道」，Ayane？

lines.en: : I think it’s only like 40,000 Yen to rent out the men's side per hour. The girls’ one is a lot more expensive because, well, girls actually exist in Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 我想男汤每小时只要大概四万日元。女汤贵多了，因为，嗯，Kumon-mi 里真的有女孩。

lines.en: : Men exist as well. Just...less of them.
lines.zh: : 男人也有。只是……少一点。

lines.en: scene ayanebathredux3
: You’re the only man that exists for me, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 对我来说，存在的男人只有你一个，老师。

lines.en: : Thank you?...
scene ayanebathredux4
: Well, you and Geoffrey.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你，还有 Geoffrey。

lines.en: : And I guess my dad by default.
lines.zh: : 还有我爸，默认算上。

lines.en: : But mostly you.
lines.zh: : 不过主要是你。

lines.en: : But anyway, I packed an extra towel for you, so you don’t need to worry about the weird public ones they probably only clean like, once every three days.
lines.zh: : 总之，我给你多带了一条毛巾，所以你不用担心那些奇怪的公用毛巾——它们大概三天才洗一次。

lines.en: : So, are you excited to see me naked again or are you still “desensitized” to it?
lines.zh: : 那么，你兴奋要再看到我裸体了吗，还是你依然「脱敏」了？

lines.en: I wasn’t exactly planning on spending the night in a public bathhouse but, I guess something like that could be nice every once in a while.
lines.zh: 我本来没打算在公共澡堂过夜，不过我想偶尔来一次这种事也挺不错。

lines.en: Ayane and I haven’t really had any time to relax together since the beach, and...
lines.zh: Ayane 和我从海滩之后就没真的有时间一起放松，而且……

lines.en: if ayanelust10 == True:
Well, frankly, I’m still a little confused about how to even bring what happened with Kirin up.
lines.zh: 嗯，坦白说，我还是有点拿不准该怎么把 Kirin 那件事提出来。

lines.en: It seems like Ayane’s been content with just ignoring it so far and that’s...weird to me.
lines.zh: 看起来 Ayane 到目前为止都满足于干脆无视它，而那对我来说……很怪。

lines.en: Here’s hoping I’ll be able to actually gauge how she feels about that tonight instead of putting up with her immense talent to deflect anything and everything.
lines.zh: 希望今晚我真能摸清她对那件事的感受，而不是继续忍受她把一切、什么都岔开的巨大天赋。

lines.en: I don’t want her to just keep pretending to be happy if she’s not.
lines.zh: 我不想她明明不开心，却一直假装开心。

lines.en: She does that often.
lines.zh: 她经常那样。

lines.en: It’s the worst thing about her, if I’m being honest.
lines.zh: 说实话，那是她最糟的一点。

lines.en: Granted, that isn’t exactly saying much since she doesn’t have many bad qualities, but-
lines.zh: 当然，考虑到她本来也没什么缺点，这么说也算不上什么——不过——

lines.en: else:
Well, something like that might actually be a good change for us.
lines.zh: 嗯，像那样的事对我们也许反而是个好的改变。

lines.en: She’s clearly hyperactive and I’m admittedly tense all of the time, so finding out a way for the two of us to wind down sounds pretty solid to-
lines.zh: 她明显过度活跃，而我承认我总是一直紧绷，所以找到一种让我俩都放松下来的方式，听起来相当靠谱——

lines.en: scene ayanebathredux5
: Sensei? You’re zoning out. Is everything okay?
lines.zh: : 老师？你走神了。没事吧？

lines.en: scene ayanebathredux3
: Oh, wait! You started zoning out the second I mentioned my naked body. You aren’t desensitized at all, are you?
lines.zh: : 哦，等等！我刚提到我的裸体你就开始走神了。你根本没脱敏，对吧？

lines.en: : Wanna go back into my room for a quickie before we head over to the baths? It might help to get some of that energy out of you.
lines.zh: : 要不要回我屋里来个快的，然后再去澡堂？说不定能帮你把那股劲儿泄掉。

lines.en: if day < 6:
: Please don't say things like that when there are other girls in the hallway.
lines.zh: : 走廊里还有别的女孩时，请别说那种话。

lines.en: else:
: Well, it’s true that no one else seems to be around right now but...
lines.zh: : 嗯，眼下确实也没别人在附近，不过……

lines.en: : Maybe it would be better if we just took advantage of the bathhouse instead?
lines.zh: : 也许我们干脆去澡堂那边利用一下更好？

lines.en: : Whatever you say, Sensei~
lines.zh: : 你说什么都行，老师～

lines.en: : It just might be hard for us to do anything at the bathhouse since the staff could show up at any moment.
lines.zh: : 只是在澡堂里我们大概不好干什么，因为工作人员随时可能出现。

lines.en: : But we’ll see...
lines.zh: : 不过看看吧……

lines.en: scene black
We’ll see, huh?
lines.zh: 看看吧，是吧？

lines.en: Normally, I feel like Ayane would have jumped at the thought of messing around in public.
lines.zh: 正常情况下，我觉得 Ayane 一听到要在公共场合乱来，就会立刻跳起来。

lines.en: Maybe the Kirin thing has gotten to her after all?...
lines.zh: 也许 Kirin 那件事终究还是影响到她了？……

lines.en: scene ayanebathredux6
We show up at the bathhouse roughly twenty minutes later and Ayane semi-awkwardly approaches a girl that looks to be around her age at the desk.
lines.zh: 大约二十分钟后我们到了澡堂，Ayane 半尴尬地走向柜台前一个看起来跟她年纪相仿的女孩。

lines.en: : Heeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeey...
Nevermind. It isn't semi-awkward at all. It is 100%% awkward.
lines.zh: 当我没说。那根本不是半尴尬。那是百分之百的尴尬。

lines.en: : We'd, uhh...like to rent out the entire men's side of the bath for a couple hours.
lines.zh: : 我们，呃……想包下整个男汤，用几个小时。

lines.en: : Just the two of you?
lines.zh: : 就你们两个？

lines.en: : You do know how that looks, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道这看起来像什么，对吧？

lines.en: : Completely and totally normal?
lines.zh: : 完全、彻底地正常？

lines.en: scene ayanebathredux7
: If it's not allowed, feel free to kick us out. I had a feeling this wasn't going to work anyway.
lines.zh: : 要是不允许，尽管把我们轰出去。我本来就觉得这事成不了。

lines.en: : It's not that it's not allowed. We can rent out that side of the bathhouse to pretty much anybody since there's no one around to use it anymore.
lines.zh: : 不是不允许。那半边澡堂我们基本可以租给任何人，因为已经没人会去用它了。

lines.en: : I just know that I'm going to have to be the one to clean up after you two are done doing whatever disgusting things you came here to do and I really don't want to have to deal with that tonight.
lines.zh: : 我只是知道，等你们俩干完来这儿要干的那些恶心事之后，收拾残局的人会是我，而我今晚真不想处理那个。

lines.en: : You're...very forward about this.
lines.zh: : 你……对这事真直白。

lines.en: : Yeah, that's kind of my thing.
lines.zh: : 对，那是我的风格。

lines.en: scene ayanebathredux8
: You're...not going to, like...report us or anything, are you?
lines.zh: : 你……不会去，呃……举报我们什么的吧？

lines.en: : You are greatly overestimating how involved in this affair I want to be.
lines.zh: : 你严重高估了我想掺和进这件事的程度。

lines.en: : We're really just here to take a bath.
lines.zh: : 我们真的只是来泡澡的。

lines.en: scene ayanebathredux9
: And I'm really just here to take your money and ask you very kindly to not clog the filters in the bath with bodily fluids.
lines.zh: : 而我真的只是来收你的钱，并非常客气地请你别用体液堵住澡堂的滤网。

lines.en: I don't think I'm going to return to this bathhouse any time soon.
lines.zh: 我想我短期内不会再来这家澡堂了。

lines.en: : Listen, we-
lines.zh: : 听着，我们——

lines.en: : Nope! Looking away. Not involved. Your total is 50,000 yen. Just leave the money on the table and we can all forget this ever happened.
lines.zh: : 不！我转开脸。不参与。你们总共五万日元。把钱放桌上，我们全都可以当这事从没发生过。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Is there an ATM here? Because that's more cash than I have on me at the moment.
lines.zh: : 这儿有 ATM 吗？因为我身上没那么多现金。

lines.en: scene ayanebathredux10
: There's a convenience store down the road.
lines.zh: : 沿路有家便利店。

lines.en: scene black
Ayane and I make an awkward trip to the convenience store for more money and I attempt on the way to coerce her into backing out of this.
lines.zh: Ayane 和我尴尬地跑去便利店取钱，一路上我试图劝她算了。

lines.en: Of course, she doesn't agree since we have already made it through the hard part, and we wind up, once again, entering the bathhouse and doing our best impressions of people who are not sexually attracted to one another.
lines.zh: 当然她不同意，因为最难的部分我们已经熬过去了，于是我俩又一次走进澡堂，尽力扮演两个对彼此没有性吸引力的人。

lines.en: Thankfully, the girl at the counter doesn't ask any questions this time and takes Ayane's money before pointing us in the direction of the bath.
lines.zh: 谢天谢地，柜台那女孩这次什么都没问，收了 Ayane 的钱，指了个方向让我们去浴池。

lines.en: if ayanelust10 == False:
So...everything kind of works out in the end if you're able to ignore the fact that a random teenager now knows more about our relationship than literally anyone else.
lines.zh: 所以……如果你能无视「一个随机少女现在对我们关系的了解，比世上任何人都多」这个事实，一切到最后多少还算顺利。

lines.en: I'm sure nothing bad will come out of that at all.
lines.zh: 我确信那绝对不会闹出什么坏事。

lines.en: else:
So...everything kind of works out in the end if you're able to ignore the fact that yet another teenager knows about Ayane and me now...
lines.zh: 所以……如果你能无视「又一个少女现在知道了 Ayane 和我」这个事实，一切到最后多少还算顺利。

lines.en: scene ayanesenseibath1
: So, uhh...that was weird. Right?
lines.zh: : 那么，呃……那挺怪的。对吧？

lines.en: : I had this whole cover story about you being my step-dad planned out, but I didn't even get to use it since I started blanking as soon as we reached the counter.
lines.zh: : 我本来准备了一整套「你是我继父」的掩护说辞，结果我们一到柜台我就开始大脑空白，根本没用上。

lines.en: : To be fair, I doubt she would have bought it anyway. That girl has clearly seen some things.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，我怀疑她本来也不会信。那姑娘显然见过世面。

lines.en: scene ayanesenseibath2

: You don't think she's going to tell anyone, do you? Because if we get in that bath and the police show up to take you away, we're going to have to run away naked and that sounds kind of embarrassing.
lines.zh: : 你觉得她不会告诉别人吧？因为要是我们在那个浴池里，警察跑来把你带走，我们就得光着身子逃跑，那听起来挺丢人的。

lines.en: : Embarrassment would be the least of our problems if that were to happen but, honestly...I don't think she will.
lines.zh: : 真到那一步，丢人就是我们最小的问题了。不过说实话……我觉得她不会。

lines.en: : I really hope not. I don't want to imagine a life where the two of us couldn't do things like this.
lines.zh: : 我真希望不会。我不想去想象一种我俩没法再做这种事的人生。

lines.en: : You mean the life we almost had up until like, five minutes ago? Because I probably don't have to remind you, but this just barely worked.
lines.zh: : 你是说我们直到大概五分钟前几乎过着的那种人生？因为我大概不用提醒你，这事刚刚才勉强成了。

lines.en: scene ayanesenseibath3
: That may be true, but we're here now! So we should start thinking more about each other and less about the girl who now probably knows but hopefully doesn't know about our secret.
lines.zh: : 那也许是真的，可我们现在就在这儿了！所以我们该多想想彼此，少想想那个现在大概知道、但希望不知道我们秘密的女孩。

lines.en: : She definitely knows, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 她肯定知道，Ayane。

lines.en: if ayanelust10 == True:
scene ayanesenseibath2
: We don't know that! It could still be a huge misunderstanding or something!
lines.zh: : 我们不知道！那也可能还是个巨大的误会什么的！

lines.en: : It's nothing like-
lines.zh: : 它一点也不像——

lines.en: scene ayanesenseibath4
: It's nothing like...
lines.zh: : 它一点也不像……

lines.en: : What happened with Kirin...
lines.zh: : 跟 Kirin 发生的那件事……

lines.en: Ahh, there it is.
lines.zh: 啊，来了。

lines.en: It was only a matter of time.
lines.zh: 那只是时间问题。

lines.en: scene black
: Come on. Let's get in the bath that we just paid a disgusting amount of money for instead of having an entire conversation directly outside of it.
lines.zh: : 来吧。我们进那个刚为它付了一笔恶心钱的浴池，而不是就在浴池外面把这整场对话聊完。

lines.en: : Y...Yeah.
lines.zh: : 好……好的。

lines.en: : Hey, wait a second! You didn't pay anything at all! My money isn't your money until you sign the marriage papers!
lines.zh: : 嘿，等一下！你一分钱都没付！在你签结婚文件之前，我的钱不是你的钱！

lines.en: : Just forge my signature. You memorized it, right?
lines.zh: : 伪造我的签名就行。你背下来了吧？

lines.en: : I tried! But apparently we both have to be present for it.
lines.zh: : 我试过了！可 apparently 我俩必须都在场才行。

lines.en: : Ayane, don't tell me you actually-
lines.zh: : Ayane，别告诉我你真的——

lines.en: : Sorry, Sensei. Are you saying something? I can't hear you over the sound of my love!
lines.zh: : 抱歉，老师。你在说什么？我听不见，我被爱的声音盖住了！

lines.en: else:
scene ayanesenseibath5
: Well, uhh...
: Maybe she'll feel more inclined to keep it a secret if we invite her in as well?
lines.zh: : 也许要是我们把她也请进来，她会更愿意保密？

lines.en: : Genius plan. You go ask her and I'll wait here for the impending threesome.
lines.zh: : 天才计划。你去问她，我在这儿等那场即将到来的三人行。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Is that really what you want?
lines.zh: : 你真想要那个？

lines.en: : Ayane, no.
lines.zh: : Ayane，不。

lines.en: : Well, yes. But no.
lines.zh: : 嗯，想。不过不。

lines.en: : That was obviously sarcasm.
lines.zh: : 那显然是反话。

lines.en: scene ayanesenseibath5r
: Well, I'm sorry for not picking up on it! It's hard enough ignoring the outline of your penis through your towel!
lines.zh: : 嗯，抱歉我没听出来！光是隔着你的毛巾忽略你阴茎的轮廓就已经够难了！

lines.en: : Then stop staring at it.
lines.zh: : 那就别盯着它。

lines.en: : I can't! It's like it's calling my name!
lines.zh: : 我忍不住！它像在叫我的名字！

lines.en: : I think this might be sexual harassment.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这可能算性骚扰了。

lines.en: : Just...ignore anything I say until we're in the penis!
lines.zh: : 干脆……在我进到阴茎里之前，忽略我说的任何话！

lines.en: : I mean bath! Ignore anything I say until we're in the bath!
lines.zh: : 我是说浴池！在我进到浴池里之前，忽略我说的任何话！

lines.en: : No! You're a pervert!
lines.zh: : 不！你是个变态！

lines.en: scene black
I sigh to myself and remove my towel, watching from behind as Ayane lowers herself into the bath.
lines.zh: 我暗自叹了口气，取下毛巾，从背后看着 Ayane 把自己沉进浴池。

lines.en: scene nightsky
The cold air of an encroaching winter confuses my skin as I come into contact with the water.
lines.zh: 当我接触水面时，逼近的冬天的冷空气把我的皮肤搞糊涂了。

lines.en: I move over to Ayane, who has since slumped down to the point where I can no longer see any of her “features.”
lines.zh: 我挪到 Ayane 身边——她已经沉到了我看不见她任何「特征」的程度。

lines.en: She notices me staring and pops above the water for a moment, teasing me with a brief flash of her chest before sitting back down.
lines.zh: 她注意到我在看，于是从水里冒出来一瞬，用短暂一闪的胸部逗我，然后又坐了回去。

lines.en: Sensing I won’t be getting any more than that, I take my place beside her...
lines.zh: 感觉到我再也得不到更多，我就在她旁边的位置坐下……

lines.en: scene ayanesenseibath6
The two of us sit in silence for a few minutes, listening to the soft sounds of running water and occasional gusts of wind.
lines.zh: 我俩沉默地坐了几分钟，听着流水轻柔的声音和偶尔刮过的风。

lines.en: Despite half of my body being submerged in nearly-scalding water, the top part of me can’t help but freeze.
lines.zh: 尽管我半个身子泡在近乎滚烫的水里，上半身还是忍不住冻着。

lines.en: The feeling of Ayane’s back pressing up against mine provides some temporary relief, but does nothing for my chest.
lines.zh: Ayane 的背贴着我的背，提供了一些暂时的缓解，但对我的胸口毫无帮助。

lines.en: I’m sure she’s in the same boat.
lines.zh: 我确信她也一样。

lines.en: : Are you also freezing?
lines.zh: : 你也冻着吗？

lines.en: : I’m actually kind of burning up.
lines.zh: : 我其实有点烧起来了。

lines.en: : And no, not because I’m horny.
lines.zh: : 而且不，不是因为我发情。

lines.en: : Are you horny, though?
lines.zh: : 那你发情吗？

lines.en: : Am I ever not horny?
lines.zh: : 我什么时候不发情？

lines.en: : Maybe like once or twice since I’ve met you, you haven’t been.
lines.zh: : 也许自从认识你以来，有那么一两次没有。

lines.en: scene ayanesenseibath7
: You’re the same, though. Aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 可你也一样。不是吗？

lines.en: : For the most part. Which is why I’m surprised we’re not having sex right now.
lines.zh: : 大体上是。所以我很惊讶我们现在没在做爱。

lines.en: : We can have sex when we get home if you want.
lines.zh: : 想的话我们回家再做。

lines.en: : Or we can go to your house and have sex after this.
lines.zh: : 或者这之后去你家做。

lines.en: : I don’t think I want to do it in the bath, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得我不想在浴池里做。

lines.en: : Baths are meant for getting clean, not dirty.
lines.zh: : 浴池是用来洗干净的，不是用来弄脏的。

lines.en: : Couldn’t you have just taken a bath at the dorm then?
lines.zh: : 那你不能在宿舍泡个澡就算了？

lines.en: : We only have showers in the dorm. And it wouldn’t have been easy for me to sneak you into them.
lines.zh: : 宿舍只有淋浴。而且我要把你偷偷带进去也不容易。

lines.en: : Are you not pleased with our alone time here? Even after all of the money I spent on it?
lines.zh: : 你对我们在这儿独处不满意吗？哪怕我为此花了一大笔钱？

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m sure that 50,000 Yen is putting a huge dent in your savings.
lines.zh: : 对，我确信那五万日元把你的存款砸了个大洞。

lines.en: scene ayanesenseibath8
: Hahah~ It sure is...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈～确实……

lines.en: : I am never going to financially recover from this.
lines.zh: : 我永远无法从财务上恢复过来了。

lines.en: scene ayanesenseibath9
: Oh, speaking of finances, you’re not opposed to me bribing the principal to end up in your class again next year, are you?
lines.zh: : 哦，说到钱，我不反对贿赂校长、让我明年再分到你们班吧？

lines.en: : I think I can get Ami and me in. I’m not sure about Maya, though.
lines.zh: : 我想我能把我和 Ami 弄进去。不过 Maya 我不确定。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure Maya would prefer to be in a different class anyway.
lines.zh: : 我很确定 Maya 本来就更愿意待在别的班。

lines.en: : Not if Ami and I are with you. She needs at least one of us or everybody will think she’s a weirdo.
lines.zh: : 除非我和 Ami 跟你在一起。她需要我们中至少一个，不然大家会觉得她是个怪人。

lines.en: : Good. She is a weirdo.
lines.zh: : 对。她就是个怪人。

lines.en: scene ayanesenseibath10
: You’re not supposed to talk down to people who aren’t here, you know?
lines.zh: : 你知道不该在背后贬低不在场的人吧？

lines.en: : It would be completely different if Maya were bathing with us. But alas, ‘tis just you and I.
lines.zh: : 要是 Maya 跟我们一起泡，那就完全不同了。可叹，只有你和我。

lines.en: : Two lovers half-submerged in public bathwater, forced to keep our chests underneath the water to stop our nipples from getting hard.
lines.zh: : 两个恋人半泡在公共的洗澡水里，被迫把胸口藏在水面下，免得乳头硬起来。

lines.en: : I’m too tall to be able to do that.
lines.zh: : 我太高了，做不到那个。

lines.en: : Yeah, you’re kind of big for a Japanese man.
lines.zh: : 是啊，对日本男人来说你算大的。

lines.en: : Meanwhile I’m the ideal [teenage]girl. A perfectly-sized specimen for you to experiment with.
lines.zh: : 而我是理想的[teenage]女孩。一个尺寸完美的样本，供你实验。

lines.en: : Want to conduct an experiment together, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 想一起做个实验吗，老师？

lines.en: : A sexual experiment?
lines.zh: : 性实验？

lines.en: scene ayanesenseibath11
: How about an emotional one instead?
lines.zh: : 不如换成情感实验？

lines.en: : How does your size have anything to do with your emotions?
lines.zh: : 你的尺寸跟你的情感有什么关系？

lines.en: : Shhh, don’t think too much about it.
lines.zh: : 嘘，别想太多。

lines.en: : What we’re going to do is ask each other one question that we’re forced to answer and can’t talk our way out of.
lines.zh: : 我们要做的是：各问对方一个问题，对方必须回答，不许用话术绕开。

lines.en: : This sounds like a very dangerous experiment.
lines.zh: : 这听起来是个非常危险的实验。

lines.en: : Don’t worry. My question for you will be easy. I’ll even go first.
lines.zh: : 别担心。我要问你的问题会很简单。我甚至可以第一个来。

lines.en: scene ayanesenseibath12
: Does that work for you, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 这样可以吗，老师？

lines.en: : It’s just an experiment, so there’s a chance nothing comes of it.
lines.zh: : 这只是个实验，所以有可能什么结果都没有。

lines.en: : But there’s also a big chance that we could discover something amazing about one another.
lines.zh: : 但也有很大的可能，我们能发现彼此身上某种了不起的东西。

lines.en: : And I, for one, want to know everything I possibly can about you since we’ll be spending our entire lives together.
lines.zh: : 而我个人，想尽可能多地了解你的一切，因为我们要共度一生。

lines.en: : I hope.
lines.zh: : 希望吧。

lines.en: I might be in a bit of trouble if Ayane’s question is actually whether or not I want to spend my entire life with her.
lines.zh: 要是 Ayane 的问题真的是「我愿不愿意跟她共度一生」，我可能有点麻烦了。

lines.en: I mean, I’m not exactly opposed. At least not right now.
lines.zh: 我是说，我并不反对。至少现在不。

lines.en: But that’s a huge commitment for someone her age and answering incorrectly might wind up hurting her.
lines.zh: 可那对她这个年纪的人来说是个巨大的承诺，而答错了可能会伤到她。

lines.en: So...let’s just hope the question is something a little easier than that.
lines.zh: 所以……就祈祷那个问题比这个稍微容易一点吧。

lines.en: : Fine.
: Ask away.
lines.zh: : 问吧。

lines.en: : Okay~ But remember, you need to be completely honest.
lines.zh: : 好～不过记住，你得完全诚实。

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. I’ll be honest.
lines.zh: : 行，行。我会诚实的。

lines.en: Probably.
lines.zh: 大概吧。

lines.en: : Go ahead, then.
lines.zh: : 那么，开始吧。

lines.en: : Ask me anything.
lines.zh: : 问我任何事。

lines.en: : Okay.
scene ayanesenseibath13
Ayane goes quiet for a minute.
lines.zh: Ayane 安静了一分钟。

lines.en: I feel her back press up against mine a little harder, like she’s trying to absorb my warmth in order to feel comfortable or something corny like that.
lines.zh: 我感觉她的背更用力地贴着我的背，像是在吸收我的体温，好让自己舒服一点，或者类似那种肉麻的事。

lines.en: That sounds like a thing Ayane would do.
lines.zh: 那听起来像是 Ayane 会干的事。

lines.en: I wonder if this question is really going to be easy, though?
lines.zh: 不过我好奇这个问题真会很简单吗？

lines.en: It seems like she’s having a hard time getting it out.
lines.zh: 看起来她很难把它说出来。

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : 老师……

lines.en: : Do you...
lines.zh: : 你觉得……

lines.en: scene ayanesenseibath14
: Do you think I’d be a good mom?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我会是个好妈妈吗？

lines.en: : That’s your question?
lines.zh: : 那就是你的问题？

lines.en: : Yeah. And you have to answer it. Those are the rules.
lines.zh: : 对。而且你必须回答。那是规则。

lines.en: : Can I ask why you’d ask something like that?
lines.zh: : 我能问问你为什么会问那种事吗？

lines.en: scene ayanesenseibath15
: If that’s what you want to waste your question on.
lines.zh: : 如果那就是你想浪费问题的地方。

lines.en: if ayanelust10 == True:
: No. I think I’ve got another question for you instead.
lines.zh: : 不。我想我换了个问题问你。

lines.en: : So let me answer yours first.
lines.zh: : 那我先答你的。

lines.en: : Mhm...I’m waiting.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼……我等着呢。

lines.en: else:
: Get back to me on that. I’m not sure if I’ll be able to think of something yet.
lines.zh: : 这个我回头再说。我不确定我现在能不能想出什么。

lines.en: : Roger. Answer mine then, please.
lines.zh: : 收到。那么请回答我的。

lines.en: Ayane as a mom, huh?
lines.zh: Ayane 当妈妈，是吗？

lines.en: I’m hoping she doesn’t mean now.
lines.zh: 我希望她指的不是现在。

lines.en: Because if she even jokes about being pregnant again, I will drown her and my unborn child in this very bath.
lines.zh: 因为要是她哪怕拿怀孕开玩笑，我就把她和我未出生的孩子一起溺死在这个浴池里。

lines.en: Just kidding.
lines.zh: 开玩笑的。

lines.en: I’d never drown Ayane or an unborn child of mine.
lines.zh: 我永远不会溺死 Ayane，或者我未出生的孩子。

lines.en: In fact, I don’t even want to think of having a child right now, so I’ll isolate Ayane’s personality and completely take myself out of the equation for this question.
lines.zh: 事实上，我现在连想要个孩子都不想，所以我会把 Ayane 的性格单独拎出来，把自己完全从这个问题的方程里摘掉。

lines.en: : I think...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……

lines.en: : Yeah.
: I think you’d be a good mom.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你会是个好妈妈。

lines.en: scene ayanesenseibath16
: Really?! You mean that?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？！你认真的？

lines.en: : Obviously not right now, but when you’re ready.
lines.zh: : 显然不是现在，而是等你准备好的时候。

lines.en: : You’re one of the most caring people I’ve ever met. You’re confident. Optimistic.
lines.zh: : 你是我见过最体贴的人之一。你自信。乐观。

lines.en: : You’re a lot of great qualities wrapped into one tiny person.
lines.zh: : 你把一堆很棒的品质包进了一个小小的身体里。

lines.en: : And sure, you’re incredibly obnoxious a lot of the time and almost unbearably clingy-
lines.zh: : 当然，你很多时候吵得要命，而且黏人到几乎无法忍受——

lines.en: : Yeah. Those are both true. I know.
lines.zh: : 对。那两点都是真的。我知道。

lines.en: : Even though they’re true, though, I think you’d be a good mother.
lines.zh: : 不过就算那是真的，我觉得你会是个好母亲。

lines.en: : The kind that would devote her entire life to her kids.
lines.zh: : 那种会把自己一生都献给孩子的母亲。

lines.en: scene ayanesenseibath17
: Well I’d obviously have to devote some of myself to you since you’d be their daddy, but I think you’re mostly right.
lines.zh: : 嗯，既然你会是孩子们的爸爸，我显然得分一些给你，不过我觉得你大体上说对了。

lines.en: : There’s nothing worse for a kid than a parent who doesn’t seem to care about them...So if I ever have a baby, I’ll make her the center of my world.
lines.zh: : 对一个孩子来说，没有什么比有个看起来不在乎他的家长更糟……所以我要是有了宝宝，我会让她成为我世界的中心。

lines.en: : I’ll use all of my money to buy her anything she wants and teach her karate and let her dye her hair any color she can think of.
lines.zh: : 我会用我所有的钱给她买任何她想要的东西，教她空手道，让她把头发染成她能想到的任何颜色。

lines.en: : You’ve already decided that your imaginary child is going to be a girl?
lines.zh: : 你已经决定了你那个想象中的孩子是女孩？

lines.en: : Of course. Boys are harder to take care of. Probably.
lines.zh: : 当然。男孩更难照顾。大概吧。

lines.en: : I don’t know. I’ve never been a mom before.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我从没当过妈妈。

lines.en: : But I want to someday.
lines.zh: : 但我想有朝一日当上。

lines.en: : I want to start a big family and live happily ever after in some cottage outside of everything.
lines.zh: : 我想组建一个大家庭，在一切之外的一间小屋里幸福地生活下去。

lines.en: : I’d wait for you to come home every day and have dinner on the table when you get there.
lines.zh: : 我每天等你回家，你进门时晚饭已经摆在桌上。

lines.en: : And after you'd finish eating, I’d bring you upstairs and give you a blowjob on the bed while our kids watch TV.
lines.zh: : 而等你吃完，我会把你带上楼，在床上给你口交，同时我们的孩子看电视。

lines.en: : I like that last part a lot.
lines.zh: : 最后那部分我很喜欢。

lines.en: Not so much the part about the kids, though.
lines.zh: 不过关于孩子的那部分就没那么喜欢了。

lines.en: scene ayanesenseibath18
: Heheh~ I figured you would.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿～我就知道你会。

lines.en: : We’re gonna have to be careful about how much we have sex or we’ll wind up having more kids than we can take care of.
lines.zh: : 我们得小心做爱的次数，不然会生出多到我们照顾不过来的孩子。

lines.en: : I think even I might pull the plug after like, nine.
lines.zh: : 我想连我自己大概也会在第九个左右踩刹车。

lines.en: : You should worry about taking care of one first before setting your cut-off at nine.
lines.zh: : 在把上限设在九个之前，你该先担心能不能照顾好一个。

lines.en: : Hurry up and give me one so I can try it out, then.
lines.zh: : 那就赶紧给我一个，我好试试。

lines.en: : Absolutely not.
lines.zh: : 绝对不行。

lines.en: : Pleeeeeeease?
: Ayane.
lines.zh: : Ayane。

lines.en: scene ayanesenseibath19
: I’m kidding, I’m kidding~
lines.zh: : 我开玩笑，我开玩笑～

lines.en: : If you think we should wait, then we’ll wait.
lines.zh: : 如果你觉得我们该等，那就等。

lines.en: scene ayanesenseibath20
: I’m kind of curious about what your question for me will be now, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我现在有点好奇你要问我的问题是什么了。

lines.en: : Do you actually have something fun? Or are you going to take the easy way out and ask me about the reason for my question?
lines.zh: : 你真有什么好玩的？还是打算走捷径，问我为什么问那个问题？

lines.en: : Hmm...
if ayanelust10 == True:
: Actually, there is something I’ve been meaning to ask you.
lines.zh: : 其实，有件事我一直想问你。

lines.en: : Oh?
: I wouldn’t exactly call it “fun” though.
lines.zh: : 不过我不会把它叫作「好玩」。

lines.en: scene ayanesenseibath21
: I...think I know what it is.
lines.zh: : 我……想我知道是什么了。

lines.en: : You didn’t expect to just avoid this conversation forever, did you?
lines.zh: : 你没指望能永远躲开这场对话吧？

lines.en: : No but...I didn’t really expect you to bring it up after I told you I’d answer anything you want.
lines.zh: : 没有，不过……在我说了你问什么我都答之后，我真没料到你会提。

lines.en: : Like, literally anything.
lines.zh: : 就像，字面意义上的任何事。

lines.en: : Getting you to talk about things that are troubling you is hard enough as-is.
lines.zh: : 让你开口谈困扰你的事本来就够难了。

lines.en: : I might as well use this opportunity to see why you’ve been acting fine despite literally breaking at the beach.
lines.zh: : 我干脆利用这个机会，看看你为什么明明在海滩上 literally 崩溃了，却一直表现得像没事人。

lines.en: : Were you really worrying that much?
lines.zh: : 你真那么担心吗？

lines.en: : Call it worry. Call it curiosity. Call it whatever you want.
lines.zh: : 叫它担心。叫它好奇。随便你怎么叫。

lines.en: : But you have to answer it.
lines.zh: : 可你得回答。

lines.en: : Okay, but...
lines.zh: : 好，不过……

lines.en: scene ayanesenseibath22
: I’m going to hug you while I talk about it so you can’t run away.
lines.zh: : 我说的时候要抱着你，这样你就跑不掉了。

lines.en: : Why would I run away from a question that I asked you?
lines.zh: : 我为什么要从一个我问你的问题前跑掉？

lines.en: : Because I’m an idiot who almost ruined your life and I don’t want you to remember that and start hating me.
lines.zh: : 因为我是个差点毁了你人生的笨蛋，我不想你想起那件事然后开始恨我。

lines.en: : I don’t hate you, Ayane. I’m just a little confused about what happened back there.
lines.zh: : 我不恨你，Ayane。我只是对当时发生的事有点困惑。

lines.en: : I’ve never seen you look so scared before.
lines.zh: : 我从没见过你那么害怕。

lines.en: scene ayanesenseibath23
: I’ve never been that scared before.
lines.zh: : 我从来没那么害怕过。

lines.en: : I finally get to be together with you after all of these years as long as we keep it a secret.
lines.zh: : 这么多年之后我终于能跟你在一起了，只要我们保守秘密。

lines.en: : Of course I’d be afraid that someone finding out about it would ruin that.
lines.zh: : 我当然会怕有人发现会毁掉那一切。

lines.en: : Not to mention that a girl I’ve known since I was little is the one who found us.
lines.zh: : 更别提发现我们的，是我从小认识的女孩。

lines.en: : And that she just forced her way in like I didn’t even care about it.
lines.zh: : 而她就那么硬挤进来，像我根本不在乎似的。

lines.en: : Did you care about it?
lines.zh: : 你在乎吗？

lines.en: scene ayanesenseibath24
: Of course!
lines.zh: : 当然！

lines.en: : My biggest fears in the entire world are you leaving me for someone else and caterpillars.
lines.zh: : 我在这世上最怕的两件事，就是你为了别人离开我，还有毛毛虫。

lines.en: : You’re afraid of caterpillars?
lines.zh: : 你怕毛毛虫？

lines.en: : Yes! But that doesn’t matter right now.
lines.zh: : 对！不过那现在不重要。

lines.en: : Kirin’s really pretty and petite and flirty and funny and a bunch of other stuff.
lines.zh: : Kirin 真的很漂亮、娇小、会撩、有趣，还有一堆别的优点。

lines.en: : And yeah I’m all of those things too, but what if you like her more for some reason?
lines.zh: : 而我也是那些样子，可万一你因为某种原因更喜欢她呢？

lines.en: : You didn’t even try to stop her from touching you, so that made me even more nervous.
lines.zh: : 你甚至没试着阻止她碰你，那让我更紧张了。

lines.en: : I didn’t really think I was in the position to be calling any shots there.
lines.zh: : 我真不觉得当时我处在能发号施令的位置。

lines.en: scene ayanesenseibath25
: I know that...and I’m not blaming you.
lines.zh: : 我知道……我不是在怪你。

lines.en: : It’s my fault for being so careless and not even checking to see if anyone was in the room.
lines.zh: : 是我太不小心，连房间里有没有人都不检查一下。

lines.en: : I still don’t understand why she was there in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我还是不明白她一开始为什么会在那儿。

lines.en: : Neither do I, but she was and she caught us and I was worried that this was all going to end right there.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道，可她就在那儿，她撞见了我们，而我担心一切就要当场完蛋。

lines.en: : Also, she said some really mean things to me while it was happening and I didn’t know how to handle it.
lines.zh: : 而且事情发生的时候她对我说了些非常刻薄的话，我不知道该怎么处理。

lines.en: : What did she say to you afterwards? You guys went outside to talk, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 她之后跟你说了什么？你们出去谈了，是吧？

lines.en: : Just some stuff about how she wouldn’t tell anyone and that it wasn’t a big deal.
lines.zh: : 就一些「她不会告诉任何人」「那没什么大不了」之类的话。

lines.en: : It definitely felt like a big deal to me, though.
lines.zh: : 不过对我来说，那绝对感觉是大件事。

lines.en: : Have you talked since then?
lines.zh: : 从那以后你们聊过吗？

lines.en: scene ayanesenseibath26
: Not at all. She hasn’t even tried reaching out.
lines.zh: : 完全没有。她甚至没试着联系我。

lines.en: : And I’ve been really on edge because I know she could tell anyone whenever she wants.
lines.zh: : 而我一直非常紧张，因为我知道她随时能告诉任何人。

lines.en: : And Kirin is pretty popular so people would definitely listen to her as well.
lines.zh: : 而且 Kirin 挺受欢迎的，所以大家肯定也会听她的。

lines.en: : Your career would be ruined and my dad would find out and probably force me to get homeschooled or something.
lines.zh: : 你的事业会完蛋，我爸会发现，大概会逼我在家上学什么的。

lines.en: scene ayanesenseibath27
: All because I was too stupid and too horny to think about making sure we were safe.
lines.zh: : 全都是因为我太蠢、太发情，没想着确保我们是安全的。

lines.en: : It was a stupid idea and I hate that we had to go through that during a time that was so special and sweet.
lines.zh: : 那是个愚蠢的主意，而我讨厌我们不得不在那么特别、那么甜蜜的时刻经历那种事。

lines.en: : All I want is for you to like me. Any time something threatens that I’m probably going to freak out, so sorry in advance.
lines.zh: : 我想要的只是你喜欢我。任何威胁到那一点的东西，我大概都会崩溃，所以提前道歉。

lines.en: scene ayanesenseibath28
: Also, I’m pretty sure Kirin being there made you harder than normal and that made me angry.
lines.zh: : 还有，我挺确定 Kirin 在场让你比平时更硬，那让我生气。

lines.en: : To be fair, you were also extremely turned-on during that exchange.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，那次你来我往里你也极度兴奋。

lines.en: : I know.
lines.zh: : 我知道。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure I came on her hand. I can’t even look at her anymore.
lines.zh: : 我挺确定我在她手上射了。我连看都没法再看她了。

lines.en: : Then don’t.
lines.zh: : 那就别看。

lines.en: : Kirin’s obviously got it out for you for whatever reason, so staying away from her is probably best for both of you.
lines.zh: : Kirin 显然因为某种原因跟你过不去，所以离她远点对你们俩都最好。

lines.en: scene ayanesenseibath29
: It’s so weird, though...
lines.zh: : 可那太怪了……

lines.en: : I thought the two of us were friends.
lines.zh: : 我以为我俩是朋友。

lines.en: : I have no idea why she’d do something like that when she’s well aware of how I feel about you...
lines.zh: : 我不明白她为什么干那种事——她明明很清楚我对你的感情……

lines.en: : Some people are just...toxic, I guess.
lines.zh: : 有些人就是……有毒吧，我想。

lines.en: : I guess...
lines.zh: : 我想……

lines.en: : I don’t know. It’s a giant mess. I wish it never happened.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。一团乱麻。我真希望那事从没发生。

lines.en: : I’ll be more careful from now on, I promise.
lines.zh: : 我从现在开始会更小心的，我保证。

lines.en: : Your idea of being careful is being naked together in a public bathhouse?
lines.zh: : 你所谓的小心，就是一起裸着待在公共澡堂？

lines.en: scene ayanesenseibath30
: Baby-steps.
lines.zh: : 一步一步来。

lines.en: : I’ll get there.
lines.zh: : 我会到那儿的。

lines.en: : I’m sure you will.
lines.zh: : 我确信你会。

lines.en: scene black
Ayane and I sit in the bath for a little while longer and return to our original positions.
lines.zh: Ayane 和我在浴池里又坐了一会儿，然后回到了最初的姿势。

lines.en: She gets embarrassed about crying in front of me and needs to constantly splash water onto her face in order to get rid of her tears.
lines.zh: 她为在我面前哭而难为情，需要不停往脸上泼水好把眼泪清掉。

lines.en: Of course, the water in the bath is extremely hot, so by the time we’re out, her face is as red as a tomato.
lines.zh: 当然，浴池的水极烫，所以等我们出来时，她的脸红得像个番茄。

lines.en: But thankfully-
lines.zh: 不过谢天谢地——

lines.en: The cold air of an encroaching winter is able to return her to normal on the way home.
lines.zh: 回家路上，逼近的冬天的冷空气又把她恢复了正常。

: I think I’m going to take the easy way out.
lines.zh: : 我想我要走捷径了。

lines.en: scene ayanesenseibath18
: Booooooring.
: I don’t mind answering it, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我不介意回答。

lines.en: : Buckle up your seatbelt for some of Ayane Amamiya’s story-time.
lines.zh: : 系好安全带，天雨 Ayane 的故事时间要开始了。

lines.en: scene black
Ayane goes on to talk about the relationship she had with her mom when she was little.
lines.zh: Ayane 接着讲起她小时候和母亲的关系。

lines.en: I keep expecting her to tear up or...get emotional or anything while discussing her past, but it’s an overwhelmingly positive story.
lines.zh: 我一直等着她哭出来，或者……在讲过去时情绪上来什么的，可那 overwhelmingly 是个积极的故事。

lines.en: She goes over how her mother always placed her at the center of the world. How she’d do anything to make her feel safe.
lines.zh: 她讲到她母亲怎样永远把她放在世界的中心。怎样愿意做任何事让她感到安全。

lines.en: Or loved.
lines.zh: : 或者被爱。

lines.en: She talks about how gently she’d tuck her in before bed...how she’d help her pick out clothes when they went shopping-
lines.zh: : 她讲到睡前她会多温柔地给她掖被子……逛街时她会怎样帮她挑衣服——

lines.en: And even smaller things like how much milk she’d put in her cereal or the shape of her crooked smile.
lines.zh: : 甚至更小的事，比如她往麦片里倒多少牛奶，或者她那歪笑的形状。

lines.en: Luckily for Ayane, her smile is perfectly straight.
lines.zh: : Ayane 运气好，她的笑容完美笔直。

lines.en: And even though I could not see it with our backs pressed together, I could tell she was wearing one throughout her entire rant.
lines.zh: : 而虽然我们背靠背、我看不见，我能感觉到她整段长篇大论里都挂着那个笑。
